title: Count Modifier (2x, 3w, 5j)
instruction_text:
Prefix commands with a number to repeat them!

Examples:
  5x  = delete 5 characters
  3w  = move 3 words forward
  4j  = move 4 lines down
  2dd = delete 2 lines
  3dw = delete 3 words
  10G = go to line 10

Your task: Delete the X's efficiently using counts.

Line 1: Delete 5 X's with '5x' (not xxxxx!)
Line 2: Delete 3 words with '3dw'

Steps:
1. Cursor is on first X - press '5x'
2. Press 'j' to go to line 2
3. Press '3dw' to delete 3 words
4. Save with :wq

Counts work with almost any command!
